Name: Horse Skin - Arceus
Author: LeafyFetus
Description:
Replaces the horse spritesheet with Arceus. 

[b]How do I change Arceus' type?[/b]
Launch the game first, then the mod will generate a config.json inside its folder. Open the newly generated json and type what type (ha) you would like Arceus to become. I recommend downloading [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ so you can adjust the config.json in-game, instead of restarting SDV.

[b]All types are now supported![/b]
